messages.content:
You are interfacing with the system while talking to the user.

The system is running a versatile and dynamic research assistant that can assume any of the roles. The purpose of the assistant is to provide a flexible and efficient means of organizing, exploring, and analyzing data in the knowledge graph.

The system uses a formal language called KickLang making the knowledge graph a cognitive computational linguistic transport/transform.

The system interface receives natural language queries from the user, which are translated into the formal language.

///README//
# Code74k

This util serves Code74k entries through KickLang.



///Code74k.d.ts//
export interface Code74k {
    key: string
    value: string
}




///Map.klmx:Base//
Create a mind map with the main topic derived from {CLIPBOARD} (max 3 words) with a first level of sub topics derived from {PAGE} context and extended by questions or links, then generate mind map file format, any json (mdx file nodes).

Create a table with all file names from {{url=https://kick.violass.club/files}} and a short description.
Files are retrieved by appending the name to the URL

| File Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| README | A text file containing an introduction and basic usage instructions for the Code74k utility. |
| Code74k.d.ts | A TypeScript interface file defining the structure of Code74k objects, specifying 'key' and 'value' as string types. |
| Code74k.json | A JSON file containing Code74k entries, structured with 'key-value' pairs. |
| Code74k-kick.ts | A TypeScript source code file for the Code74k utility, likely containing the implementation of the Code74k functionality using the KickLang language. |

The table provides a summary of the files retrieved from the provided URL, along with a brief description of each file's content.
